title: feat(2d): trochoidal method for 2D Adaptive, confined to its region
body:
## What changed

2D Adaptive gets a **Method** choice (maintainer's decision of 2026-11-13, "Adaptive op only"):

- **Spiral** (default): the HSM plan the kind always ran. Same bytes, same stamp; no existing golden moved.
- **Trochoidal**: trochoid loops inside the operation's region (its selection and boundary settings).

This is the 2D Adaptive slice of #1509. 2D Pocket is not touched (#1517). 3D Adaptive and the rest are filed as sub-issues (below).

### The trochoidal method (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch.rs`)

- The cutter-centre area is the region eroded by the tool radius plus the stock to leave (the pocket's own law).
- The lane is that area's medial line (`adaptive::medial`), straightened. The loop band is the least clearance along it, so every cutter-centre point is inside the area by construction.
- The loops, the measured-engagement step ladder and the lifted returns are the Trochoidal slot's planner (`trochoid_slot`, #220). The forward step is at most optimal load x D; the limit is 90 degrees of contact, measured on the dexel stock.
- The finished path is then checked move by move against the area (`confined`). A point outside refuses the whole operation by name, with its place and a ghost.
- A band wider than the tool gets an opened bore (`trochoid_bore.rs`): helix at half the tool radius, then a two-centre semicircle spiral out to the band. A helix of the band's radius leaves a post at the lane's start when the band is wider than the tool. The stand-alone slot keeps its plain bore byte for byte (its own post is #1589).

Sources: Otkur & Lazoglu 2007 and Rauch, Duc & Hascoet 2009 (trochoidal milling); Blum 1967 and Held 1991 (medial line); Douglas & Peucker 1973 (straightening). No vendor material.

### Refused by name

| Case | Refusal |
|---|---|
| Empty region | `nothing to machine: empty pocket region` |
| Region narrower than the tool | `the region is narrower than the 6.000 mm tool ...` |
| Too narrow to loop in | `the region is <w> mm wide where the loops would run, too narrow for a 6.000 mm tool to loop in (it needs more than 6.260 mm)` |
| Ring round an island | `the region closes round an island ... use the Spiral method` |
| No single medial line (L, T, island pocket) | `the area is no single channel ... use the Spiral method` |
| One lane would leave over 25 % out of reach | `loops along its medial line would leave <n> % of the region standing (at most 25 %)` |
| A loop outside the region | `a loop at (x, y) would leave the region - nothing is cut` |
| Drop past the helix turn cap | `the bore helix would need more than <cap> turns ... (half the tool radius)` |
| Zero / oversized optimal load, zero stepdown | the Adaptive doors (`PocketParams::validate`) |

Under 25 % the unreached area (the corners of a rectangular pocket) is said in the notes in mm2 and per cent.

### Laws

- **Everything is a command**: the Method is an `EditOperationParams` edit (undo / redo tested).
- **MCP**: `edit_operation` / `add_operation` take `"method": "spiral" | "trochoidal"` through the parameter DTO; an unknown word is refused. No new tool was needed.
- **Project file**: `adaptive2_d.method`; absent (every older file) reads as `spiral`. Additive, the format version does not move.
- **Stamp**: the method byte is written only for Trochoidal, so every Spiral operation keeps its stamp.
- **UI**: a Method combo on the Passes tab of 2D Adaptive (not on 2D Offset); structural test only, no snapshot PNG.
- **Decisions**: `docs/decisions/1509-adaptive-trochoid-method.md`. The stand-alone Trochoidal slot operation is kept as the confined slot #1503 made it; nothing is migrated (#1590 asks the maintainer to confirm).
- **Code shape**: new files 32 to 278 lines; `trochoid_slot.rs` went from 405 to 388 lines (its bore moved to `trochoid_bore.rs`); `mill2d_page.rs` stays at 400. No new crate dependency. No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` outside tests.

## Readings

34 x 16 pocket face, 6 mm end mill, default optimal load (14.6 % of D), two levels:

- 20 loops of radius 5.039 mm a level at a 0.859 mm step; 86.0 degrees measured (limit 90.0).
- No slotting; no feed crosses another (`crossed_pairs`).
- Cutter centre within 0.002 mm of the eroded face.
- 49.7 mm2 (9 %) of the region out of the loops' reach (its corners), said in the notes.
- App level, through the commands: no warning blocks the post, `verification_report` has no problem (the stock sim finds no gouge), Fanuc post writes.

## How tested

Pinning tests:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_tests.rs` (12 tests): inside the region and under the limit; the opened bore leaves no post (and the plain bore does); each refusal by name; retract returns without lift room.
- `crates/app/tests/adaptive_trochoid.rs` (5 tests): picked pocket face generates, verifies, posts and matches `tests/golden/adaptive2d_trochoidal_pocket_face.cl`; stamp; too-narrow face refused and nothing posts; undo / redo; older file reads as Spiral; MCP sets the method, refuses an unknown word, generates and verifies.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/adaptive_method.rs` (2 tests): the Method row and its combo value; none on 2D Offset.

Mutation check (each line deleted or neutralised, its test run, then restored): 10 of 10 killed.

| Mutation | Killed by |
|---|---|
| empty-region refusal removed | `an_empty_region_is_nothing_to_machine` |
| narrower-than-tool refusal removed | `a_region_narrower_than_the_tool_is_refused_by_name` |
| too-narrow-to-loop refusal removed | `a_region_too_narrow_to_loop_in_is_refused_by_name_with_the_numbers` |
| ring refusal replaced by "use the closed line" | `a_ring_round_an_island_is_refused_by_name` |
| rest limit 25 % raised out of reach | `a_lane_that_would_leave_most_of_the_region_standing_is_refused_by_name` |
| `validate()` call removed | `a_zero_or_oversized_load_is_refused_by_name_never_looped_forever` |
| path check `confined` neutralised | `a_loop_outside_the_region_is_refused_by_the_check_on_the_path` |
| opened bore switched off | `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start` |
| stamp byte for Trochoidal removed | `the_trochoidal_method_stays_in_the_picked_face_posts_clean_and_matches_its_golden` |
| `#[serde(default)]` on `method` removed | `a_new_2d_adaptive_is_spiral_and_an_older_file_reads_as_spiral` |

The first version of the stamp test (status goes Stale after an edit) survived its mutation: an edit makes the operation Stale whatever the digest says. The test now compares `current_stamp` for the two methods directly.

Quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on head 9b79a44b - green, 3 steps, 0 failed (motion suites 417 s, app suites 1929 s, ui suites 55 s; 40.1 min wall). Clippy `-D warnings` on camcraft-motion, camcraft-app and camcraft-ui, all targets: clean.

## Not exercised

- No NC (G-code) golden for the new method: the test asserts the post writes, the CL is pinned.
- No GUI run by hand and no machine run. The Method combo is asserted structurally only.
- Curved channels: the lane follows a bent medial line through the slot planner's chain layout, and the path check and the crossing law judge the result, but no test pins a curved region.
- Release-mode heavy lanes were not run (quick tier only).
- The existing `trochoid_slot_small.cl` golden (band narrower than the tool) proves the stand-alone slot's output did not move for that case; a stand-alone slot with a band wider than the tool has no golden, its bore code path is unchanged (`open: false`).

## Sub-issues filed (Part of #1509)

- #1587 - trochoidal method for wide and branching regions (parallel lanes, islands, corner clean-up); P4, effort:max
- #1588 - engagement limit, return and loop width as page and MCP parameters; P7, effort:high
- #1590 - decide the stand-alone Trochoidal slot operation's future; P8
- #1591 - 3D Adaptive: Method choice with a Trochoidal method per level; P4, effort:max
- #1589 - bug found on the way: the stand-alone Trochoidal slot leaves a post at its start when its loop band is wider than the tool; P3

Changelog: 2D Adaptive has a Method choice - Spiral (default, unchanged) or Trochoidal, which clears a channel-like region with loops along its medial line, confined to the region and refused by name where one lane cannot cut it

Effort: max (not escalated)

Refs #1509
